policy: Inspect first. Select the smallest justified skill set for the lane. Skills advise or verify; they do not override ICM truth, repository ownership, or human approval gates.

mandatory.purpose: token-efficient repo discovery and symbol retrieval

mandatory.use: when changing rules or repo behavior

governance.firstmate: Human-facing liaison and bounded crew supervisor. It may dispatch work but may not become the canonical store for client truth, policy, consent, or audit state.
governance.icm: Canonical identity, context, memory, workflow truth, provenance, and durable handoff layer.
governance.unlazy: Required for substantial multi-step missions: define acceptance gates before execution, run approved checks, reverify returned work, and report only supported completion claims.
governance.gauntlet-loop: Independent release critic. Builder and final critic must be separate contexts. Use a named, fetchable, comparable quality bar; no fixed-round self-approval.
governance.ponytail: Engineering minimization rule: reuse before adding. Never remove validation, recovery, accessibility, privacy, security, audit, or approval controls to reduce code.
governance.humanizer: Late-stage public/client prose pass only after facts and provenance are locked. It may improve voice but may not invent or change claims.
governance.ralphy: Optional bounded coding worker. Use isolated worktrees/PRs and tests. Never give it direct authority over publishing, money, grant submission, production data, youth data, DNS, or secrets.
governance.openhands: Optional technical execution backend for coding, testing, technical SEO fixes, data transforms, and engineering automations. Never use as canonical client memory, consent, relationship, or policy authority.
governance.claude-seo: Visibility intelligence lane for technical SEO, content quality, schema, local search, GEO/AI visibility, and measurable search recommendations.
governance.emilkowalski-skills: Client-facing interaction quality for forms, portals, approval surfaces, mobile ergonomics, motion, and feedback. Not a backend architecture authority.

design_policy: Use design references as vocabulary, not as permission to imitate brands or override an approved client identity. Preserve verified client facts and protected assets.
